recognize_zh: 此組合圖中周邊血可見胞質豐富淡染的大淋巴球（LGL 型態，但本解析度下嗜天青顆粒不易辨認），骨髓切片有成團的小型成熟淋巴球浸潤，免疫組化以 T 細胞標記標出成群的陽性細胞；配合中性球減少與 T 細胞受體基因重組呈單株性，符合 T-LGL 白血病。
features: Panel A (peripheral blood): lymphocyte with mature round nucleus and moderate to abundant pale cytoplasm, consistent with a large granular lymphocyte; azurophilic granules are not well resolved at this magnification
Panel B (core biopsy, low power): fragmented marrow with focal nodular and interstitial lymphoid aggregates
Panel C (high power): aggregate of small, mature-appearing lymphocytes with round nuclei, condensed chromatin and scant cytoplasm, without atypia
Panel D (IHC): dense clusters and interstitial scattered positive lymphocytes highlighted by a T-cell-associated marker (antigen not labeled in the image)
No overt blasts or large atypical cells in the fields shown
describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows a lymphocyte with a mature nucleus and moderate to abundant pale cytoplasm consistent with a large granular lymphocyte, although cytoplasmic granules are not well resolved at this magnification. The bone marrow core biopsy is fragmented and shows nodular and interstitial aggregates of small, mature-appearing lymphocytes without significant cytologic atypia. Immunohistochemistry (antigen not specified in the image) highlights clusters and interstitial infiltrates of positive lymphocytes; in T-LGL leukemia, CD8, TIA-1 and granzyme B typically show intrasinusoidal and interstitial clusters of cytotoxic T cells. In the setting of neutropenia and a clonal T-cell receptor gene rearrangement, findings are consistent with T-cell large granular lymphocytic leukemia.

ddx.dx: Reactive large granular lymphocytosis (viral infection, post-transplant, autoimmune disease)
ddx.vs: Morphology is identical, so persistence for more than 6 months, clonal TCR rearrangement, STAT3 mutation and loss of CD5/CD7 or KIR restriction favor the neoplasm.

ddx.dx: Chronic lymphoproliferative disorder of NK cells
ddx.vs: Shows the same LGL morphology but is surface CD3-negative, CD56-positive with polyclonal TCR and KIR restriction.

ddx.dx: Chronic lymphocytic leukemia / small lymphocytic lymphoma
ddx.vs: Small lymphocytes with clumped chromatin and scant cytoplasm form paratrabecular or interstitial infiltrates that are CD5/CD23/CD20 positive B cells rather than cytotoxic T cells.
Cells are larger with atypical nuclei and nucleoli, patients are acutely ill, and EBER in situ hybridization is positive.
